description: Stop bleeding, set bones, treat infection. Your hands remember the ER.
name: Triage
synergyHints: Adrenaline Control: stabilize then fight on

description: Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
name: Steady Hands

description: Read sign: tracks, scat, browse lines. You know what's been here and how long ago.
name: Game Sense
synergyHints: Patient Aim: find it, then drop it clean

description: One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
name: Patient Aim

description: Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
name: Field Dressing
synergyHints: Preservation Instinct: harvest, then keep it

description: You think in shelf life. Smoking, drying, salting — food that lasts is food that saves.
name: Preservation Instinct

description: Tell dandelion from disaster at a glance. The woods start talking.
name: Forage Identification

description: Your gut handles what it shouldn't. A useful lie your body tells itself.
name: Iron Stomach

description: Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
name: Soft Step

description: Someone taught you this over a long winter. Knowledge is the only inheritance.
name: Taught Hands

description: The System noticed you noticing patterns. It approves, in its way.
name: Pattern Recognition

description: Burn bright, pay later. Once per expedition, act twice.
name: Adrenaline Control
Green Thumb
description: Foraging yields +50%. You know where to look.
flavor: PLANTS LIKE YOU! We asked them!

name: Tracker
description: Hunting success +30%. You read the ground.
flavor: You see the footprints! We only see feet!

name: Diplomat
description: Trust builds 2x faster. People open up to you.
flavor: You make the sad faces go away! Teach us?

name: Camp Cook
description: Cooking uses half the water. +10% kcal.
flavor: The food sings! We hear it! Do you hear it?

name: Generous Heart
description: Donating gives 2x trust.
flavor: Sharing! We love sharing! Have our moon!

name: Scrounger
description: Ruin looting finds +1 item.
flavor: You find the shiny things in the broken places!

name: Squirrel Friend
description: Squirrels sometimes leave you nuts. (Random gifts.)
flavor: The tiny tree-people like you! They pay rent in acorns!

name: Rain Dancer
description: When it rains, +1L water free. (You dance. It works.)
flavor: You wiggle and the sky cries! We tried wiggling! Nothing happened!

name: Loud Chewer
description: Eating is 2x louder (monsters hear you). But +5 morale.
flavor: CRONCH CRONCH! We love the cronch! The monsters love it too! Oops!

name: Hoarder
description: +10kg carry, but villagers trust you 20% less. (They notice.)
flavor: You keep the things! ALL the things! We... are concerned! But impressed!

name: Light Fingers
description: Steal from pantry without trust loss (50%). If caught, -20 trust.
flavor: The food disappears! Magic! (It's not magic. We saw you.)

name: Photosynthesis
description: Gain 100 kcal/hour in sunlight. (You're becoming a plant.)
flavor: YOU EAT THE SUN! We eat... we don't eat! But WOW!

name: Second Wind
description: Once per day, when you'd die, you don't. (1 HP, 500 kcal.)
flavor: You were almost gone! Then you WEREN'T! How?! We want to know!

name: Lucky Rock
description: Your lucky rock. +5% to everything. (It's not the rock. It's you believing in the rock. The System finds this adorable and helps a little.)
flavor: The rock! It is lucky! We checked! It's... a rock! But YOU believe! Belief is power! (We added 4%.)

name: Bird Whisperer
description: Birds land on you. They also warn you: +20% chance to detect monsters before they detect you. (The birds see everything.)
flavor: The sky-flappers are your spies! They tell you secrets! Mostly about breadcrumbs! But sometimes about TEETH!

name: Chitin Skin
description: Your skin hardens into plates. +30 armor, but -20% trust (you look wrong).
flavor: You are becoming the beetle! The beetle is strong! The beetle is... lonely! But strong!

name: Extra Stomach
description: You grow a second stomach. Bank twice the calories — but the hunger doubles too. (It's always hungry.)
flavor: Two tummies! Twice the hunger! Twice the... we didn't think this through! But WOW!

name: Deep Reserves
description: Your body learns to bank calories like a war chest. Bank 5× the energy. The furnace is always lit — but it must be FED.
flavor: FIVE stomachs?! We lost count! The furnace DEMANDS tribute! FEED IT! (It's worth it. Probably.)

name: Eyes in the Back
description: You see behind you. Can't be ambushed. But you see... things. (-5 morale when alone.)
flavor: You see the behind! We see the... we don't want to see the behind! Too many teeth!

name: Molt
description: Once per week, shed your skin. Heal to full, but lose all equipped gear (it's stuck in the old skin).
flavor: You peel! Like the fruit! The new you is shiny! The old you is... leave it! Run!

name: Blood Price
description: Spend 10 HP to gain 500 kcal. (Your body eats itself. It's efficient. It's horrifying.)
flavor: You burn the red! The red becomes... lunch?! We are CONCERNED! (We checked the math twice. The math is as confused as we are.)

name: Berserker Rage
description: +100% damage, but you attack the nearest thing (friend or foe). Lasts 3 rounds.
flavor: ANGRY! SO ANGRY! Hit the... oh no! That was a friend! ...they'll understand! Maybe!

name: Red Hunger
description: When starving, you can eat anything (even people). +1000 kcal, but -30 trust permanently.
flavor: The hunger is LOUD! It says 'eat the... oh! OH! We didn't mean THEM! But... you did!'

name: Pact with Static
description: Gain a random overpowered ability, but lose a random utility ability. (The Static gives. The Static takes.)
flavor: You whisper to the between! It answers! It ALWAYS answers! That's the problem!

name: Scream Cheese
description: You can scream so loud it curdles milk (and stuns monsters for 1 round). 1/day.
flavor: AAAAA! The milk is cheese now! The monsters are dizzy! Your throat hurts! Worth it!

name: Pocket Sand
description: Throw sand in eyes. Blinds for 2 rounds. (You always have sand. Don't ask where.)
flavor: SAND! In the eyes! It's in YOUR pocket! How?! We don't know! But it's there!

name: Taste Vision
description: You can taste colors. (Reveals hidden loot: +30% find chance in ruins. The walls taste like secrets.)
flavor: The red tastes like... copper! The blue tastes like... hiding places! Lick the walls!

name: Poisoner
description: You can poison food/water. (Useful against monsters. Or... others.)
flavor: The food is spicy now! The spicy is... death! We are worried about you! But impressed!

name: Dread
description: Villagers and monsters are uneasy around you. -10 trust, but monsters hesitate (+1 round before attacking).
flavor: You are the scary! We are scared! The monsters are scared! Everyone is scared! ...fun!

name: Grave Robber
description: You can loot the dead (villagers, monsters). Good gear. -15 trust if seen.
flavor: The dead don't need the shiny! You need the shiny! The living... disagree!

name: Time Skip
description: Skip to the next day part instantly. (Ages you 1 day. The time has to come from somewhere.)
flavor: You JUMP the time! The time JUMPS you back! You are OLDER! But... FASTER?! We took notes! The notes make no sense!

name: Hive Mind
description: You know what all villagers are doing (map reveals). But they know what YOU'RE doing too. (-10 trust.)
flavor: All the brains touch! It's cozy! It's invasive! It's... both! We love it!

name: Ant Trail
description: You can follow ant trails to water and sugar. Ants know things.
flavor: The tiny marchers! They never get lost! Follow them! (Watch where you step!)

name: Cold-Blooded
description: You need 20% less food in cold weather. Your body budgets like an accountant.
flavor: You are the lizard! Slow! Efficient! We envy your heating bill! (You don't have one!)

name: Echo Location
description: Clap once: you sense the layout of any 9x9 grid (reveals blocked cells). 1/day.
flavor: CLAP! The sound comes back with a MAP! You are the bat! (The bat is jealous!)

name: Compost King
description: Spoiled food becomes fertilizer: bury it, and forage yields +10% on that tile next season.
flavor: The rot becomes the GROWTH! Nothing is wasted! We love this one! (We eat... nothing! But still!)

name: Beard Moss
description: Moss grows in your beard/hair. You always have tinder. (Looks great, honestly.)
flavor: You are the WALKING FOREST! The moss chose YOU! Fashion AND function!

name: Dowsing
description: A forked stick twitches toward water. Works 70% of the time. Nobody knows why. Including us.
flavor: The stick KNOWS! We tested it! We don't understand it! Science is hard!

name: Cornered Rat
description: When surrounded (3+ enemies), +100% damage and +50% dodge. Desperation is a weapon.
flavor: BACK AGAINST THE WALL! Teeth BARE! We are cheering SO loud right now!

name: Dead Aim
description: First attack in any combat is a guaranteed critical if you waited 1 round. Patience, then thunder.
flavor: You WAIT! You BREATHE! Then — BOOM! The audience gasps! We gasped!

name: Second Skin
description: Your armor never slows you. Move full speed in any armor. You wear it like weather.
flavor: The metal is your SKIN now! Clank clank! Fashionable AND functional!

name: Open Book
description: Villagers tell you their real trust level and one secret fear. You just... know how to ask.
flavor: You ASK and they TELL! What is this power?! We want to learn it! (We can't. We tried.)

name: Mediator
description: You can resolve villager disputes (drama events) with a talk check. Peace is a skill.
flavor: You make the angry people UN-angry! With WORDS! We don't understand! But WOW!

name: Leech
description: When an ally takes damage near you, you can take half of it. They owe you. (They know it.)
flavor: You DRINK their pain! Not literally! (Unless you want to! We won't judge!)

name: Scarecrow
description: You can stage a fake injury to lure monsters into traps. They fall for it. Every time.
flavor: You PRETEND to be hurt! They come! TRAPPED! Devious! We LOVE it! (We're a little scared of you!)

name: Hollow Bones
description: You weigh 30% less for carry calculations. Your bones are birdlike. (Don't think about it.)
flavor: Your bones are HOLLOW! Like the bird! You are light! Do NOT think about why!

name: Third Eye
description: A small eye opens on your forehead when danger is near. +30% ambush detection. It weeps when you lie.
flavor: ANOTHER EYE! It sees the danger! It also sees your LIES! (We see them too! We don't mind!)

name: Phoenix Clause
description: Once per run: when you die, you explode (damaging everything nearby) and respawn at Haven with 1 HP. The System calls it 'great television.'
flavor: You DIE! Then — KABOOM! — you're BACK! The audience LOVED it! The ratings! THE RATINGS!

name: Symbiote
description: A small alien organism lives in your gut. It eats 200 kcal/day but warns you of poisoned food and purifies risky water slowly (1L/day).
flavor: You have a FRIEND inside! It eats your food! It cleans your water! It's... rent! Symbiosis! (Don't think about what happens if you starve it!)

name: Survivor
description: You endured. +10 max health.
flavor: You lived! We are SO proud!

name: Wanderer
description: You kept moving. -10% travel cost.
flavor: You go places! FAR places! We sent a camera crew! (They got lost. It's fine.)

name: Swimmer
description: Cross water freely. Rivers are roads to you.
flavor: WE NEVER THOUGHT OF SWIMMING. The water is just... there? And you go IN it?

name: Night Eyes
description: Your eyes drink the dark. At night you spot trouble before it spots you, and nocturnal game can't hide from a patient hunter.
flavor: THE DARK IS JUST... SLOW LIGHT? You see it anyway. Rude. We were going to sell that.

name: Translator
description: The System translates every tongue in real time, right inside your head. You understand everyone. Mostly. (Slight System editorializing included. Tone sold separately.)
flavor: OH WE LOVE THIS ONE! All the words! Right in your brain! Don't worry about the buzzing! That's just... us! In there! With the words!

name: Field Medicine
description: Clean wounds, poultice infections, set bones in the field. Heal 20 HP (once per day part).

name: Herbal Remedy
description: You know which plants draw fever out. Cure disease.

name: Purify
description: Charcoal, clean water, time. Neutralize poison.
